'''Research''' is completed in a [[Research Lab]], which is unlocked during the introductory section of [[Mitton University]]. An essential aspect of managing the Foundation, research grants access to new [[Courses]] which allows for new methods of teaching, and for [[:Category:Equipment|Equipments]] to be upgraded to the latest tech Two Point County has to offer. ==Research 101== To start a research project, the player must either click on the [[Research Hub]], or the [[Research Lab]]. In the research screen, a project may be selected from the available projects list. Once a project has been started, a [[Teacher]] will be required to carry out the work, who can most suitably be trained with {{i2|Staff_Training#Research|25px|Research Qualification|alt=Research-Icon|br=no}}. They will contribute research to the project over time, based on their research skill, which can be upgraded with further [[Staff_Training#Research|Staff Training]]. The researching [[Teachers]] are not required to have the {{i2|Staff_Training#Research|25px|Research Qualification|alt=Research-Icon|br=no}}, but some projects may require a [[Teacher]] trained in a [[Staff_Training#Course-specific_Development|course-specific qualification]]. Research progresses over time. There are two main methods to speeding up the generation of '''Research Points''':
''1) Staff:'' By default, the [[Research Lab]] is set to allow one [[Teacher]] to work at a time. A setting in the Room Inspector can allow further researchers to operate in the room at once.
''2) Items:'' Several [[items]] are available which provide extra [[:Category:Research Power|Research Power]]. These are usually small increases, but installing many items will have a cumulative effect. When there is no active research, [[Teachers]], in their free time, can visit the [[Research Lab]] to generate a new type of [[#Commercial_Research|Commercial Research]] over time. It should be noted that projects do not have to be completed in a single session. At any time, a project may be halted in favour of another, and no progress will be lost. Projects may even be started in one [[Campuses|campus]] and resumed in another.
